verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms the 01 docs site serves llms.txt (HTTP 200), with an index of documentation pages linked as agent-readable .md files, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Evidence beyond the probe's existence check is thin. Missing for 10: proof the index covers the full docs, an llms-full.txt or other expanded agent-oriented docs, any first-party mention of llms.txt support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
